questionnaire.name: SmartUrbanity - Public transport – How the trip feels

welcome_page.title: Public transport – How the trip feels
welcome_page.description:
How you feel when you use public transport: stress, tiredness and time.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questionnaire.title: Public transport – How the trip feels

questions.text: When you use public transport, how stressed or relaxed do you usually feel?
When you use public transport, how often do you feel anxious or overwhelmed?
When you use public transport, what makes you feel anxious or overwhelmed?

options.text: Aggressive or careless drivers, riders or pedestrians
Routes that are complicated or new to me
Not knowing when the bus, tram or train will arrive
Noise, crowds or too much going on around me
Being in a hurry or afraid of being late
Feeling alone or isolated on the way
Health problems on the way (pain, breathlessness, dizziness)

questions.text: When you use public transport, how do you feel on streets with lots of people, shops and activity?

options.text: I prefer them: I feel safer or more at ease
I like them: they make the trip nicer
It makes no difference to me
They are sometimes a bit too much for me
Crowds stress me or make it hard to get through

questions.text: When you use public transport, how tired do you usually feel when you arrive?
When you use public transport, what tires you most?

options.text: Slopes, stairs and changes in level
Carrying children, a pushchair or shopping
Stress (traffic, finding the way, being late, feeling unsafe)
Waiting or standing (at stops, in queues)
I rarely feel tired after my trips

questions.text: When you use public transport, how demanding is it compared with other ways you could travel?
questions.help: Think of both physical and mental effort. Other ways could be walking, driving or public transport.

options.text: I have no other way to travel

questions.text: When you use public transport, how often do you arrive in the time you planned?
When you use public transport, how satisfied are you overall?
When you use public transport, what are you least happy with?

options.text: Service in the evening and on public holidays
It's hard to reach or use

fr.#Not knowing when the bus, tram or train: Ne pas savoir quand le bus, le tram ou le train arrivera
fr.#Noise, crowds or too much going on arou: Du bruit, de la foule ou trop d'agitation autour de moi
fr.#Being in a hurry or afraid of being lat: Être pressé ou avoir peur d'être en retard
fr.#Feeling alone or isolated on the way: Me sentir seul ou isolé en chemin
fr.#Fear of road accidents: Peur des accidents de la route
fr.#Health problems on the way (pain, breat: Problèmes de santé en chemin (douleur, essoufflement, vertiges)

fr.#I like them: they make the trip nicer: Je les aime : elles rendent le trajet plus agréable
fr.#It makes no difference to me: Cela ne fait aucune différence pour moi
fr.#They are sometimes a bit too much for m: Elles sont parfois un peu trop pour moi
fr.#Crowds stress me or make it hard to get: La foule me stresse ou m'empêche de passer
fr.#When you use public transport, how tire: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, quel niveau de fatigue ressentez-vous en général à l’arrivée ?
fr.#When you use public transport, what tir: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, qu’est-ce qui vous fatigue le plus ?
fr.#Physical effort (walking, cycling, carr: Effort physique (marcher, pédaler, porter des sacs)
fr.#Carrying children, a pushchair or shopp: Porter des enfants, une poussette ou des courses
fr.#Stress (traffic, finding the way, being: Stress (circulation, trouver son chemin, être en retard, se sentir en danger)
fr.#Heat, noise or bad air: Chaleur, bruit ou mauvaise qualité de l'air
fr.#Waiting or standing (at stops, in queue: Attendre ou rester debout (aux arrêts, dans les files)
fr.#I rarely feel tired after my trips: Je me sens rarement fatigué après mes trajets
fr.#When you use public transport, how dema: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, dans quelle mesure est-ce exigeant par rapport aux autres moyens de se déplacer ?
fr.#Think of both physical and mental effor: Pensez à l'effort physique comme mental. Les autres façons peuvent être la marche, la conduite ou les transports en commun.
fr.#Much easier than the others: Beaucoup plus facile que les autres
fr.#I have no other way to travel: Je n'ai pas d'autre moyen de me déplacer
fr.#When you use public transport, how ofte: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, à quelle fréquence arrivez-vous dans le temps que vous aviez prévu ?
fr.#Public transport – How the trip feels: Transports en commun – Ressenti du trajet
fr.#SmartUrbanity - Public transport – How: SmartUrbanity - Transports en commun – Ressenti du trajet
